name: Wine 11.20
description:
The Wine development release 11.20 is now available.

What's new in this release:
  - Relay debugging for ARM64EC.
  - Improvements in XML validation.
  - CDROM support moved to the Mount Manager.
  - Various bug fixes.

The source is available at <https://dl.winehq.org/wine/source/11.x/wine-11.20.tar.xz>

Binary packages for various distributions will be available
from the respective [download sites][1].

You will find documentation [here][2].

Wine is available thanks to the work of many people.
See the file [AUTHORS][3] for the complete list.

[1]: https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/wikis/Download
[2]: https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/wikis/Documentation
[3]: https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/raw/wine-11.20/AUTHORS

----------------------------------------------------------------

name: Wine 11.19
description:
The Wine development release 11.19 is now available.

What's new in this release:
  - Support for vertical text in GDIPlus.
  - Unicode character tables updated to Unicode 18.0.0.
  - Caching for DNS queries.
  - Improvements to the VBScript parser.
  - Various bug fixes.

The source is available at <https://dl.winehq.org/wine/source/11.x/wine-11.19.tar.xz>

Binary packages for various distributions will be available
from the respective [download sites][1].

You will find documentation [here][2].

Wine is available thanks to the work of many people.
See the file [AUTHORS][3] for the complete list.
